description:
Hello guys and gals, it's me Mutahar again! This time we take a look at another breach of the biggest law enforcement group in the world. The FBI has had it's national crime database breached into. This year has not only been bad for their security but also the security of many high-profile networks. I think it's only about to get wilder. Thanks for watching!
